description: Change an HWP, HWPX or DOCX in place of its structure, by a list of ops applied in order: replace_text {find, replace}, set_cell {table,row,col,text}, insert_paragraph {paragraph,text}, delete_paragraph {paragraph}, set_field {name,text} (HWP), append_row {table, cells, row?} (copies row `row`, default the last, and puts it under). AI/EPS/SVG and PSD, by the object or layer ids doc_inspect lists: hide/show/delete {ids}, set_text {id,text}, replace_text {find,replace}, move {ids,dx,dy}, set_fill {ids,color}, rename {id,name}, duplicate {ids}, command {command,params} (any engine command; the format profile says where the catalogue is). out may change the format: .ai .svg .pdf .png .eps / .psd .png .jpg .pdf. Addresses come from doc_inspect, counted from 0. A broken rule stops the run before anything is written (error RULE, see ezpzfile://formats/<fmt>). dry_run checks without writing. The output is reopened and each op confirmed. For PDF use pdf_edit.

dry_run.description: Apply and check in memory, write nothing

out.description: Absolute output path. Default: next to the source with -edited

password.description: HWP/HWPX: password of an encrypted document; it is kept

name: doc_edit
title: Edit document
